What's new in 2.27.0

Your profile photo now keeps itself in sync wherever you signed in, and full screen is one click away on every image you generate.

Full screen, right on the image ⌘F

  • A Full Screen button now sits on the image itself. It fades in on the top-right corner once your image finishes developing, and brightens as you point at it. ⌘F still works exactly as before — the button just makes it easy to find.

Profile photos that stay current

  • Change your photo on another device and it arrives here. Dax now checks for a new photo as it refreshes your session, so Settings shows the current one without a manual refresh.
  • Fixed your photo reverting to an older one after signing out and back in. Dax was holding on to the first photo it ever saw for your account instead of the one you have now.
  • Fixed a missing photo staying missing. If a download didn't go through, Dax kept your last known photo and now tries again on the next refresh rather than giving up.

Also in this release

  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
